atoms.title: Strawberries dipped in dark chocolate
atoms.body: Melt a few squares of dark chocolate in a bowl over hot water. Dip strawberries halfway, lay them on baking paper, and wait ten minutes if you can.

atoms.title: One-ingredient banana ice cream
atoms.body: Slice ripe bananas and freeze them. Blitz until it goes thick and soft-serve smooth. A spoon of cocoa or peanut butter if you like.

atoms.title: Frozen yoghurt bark
atoms.body: Spread thick yoghurt on a lined tray, scatter berries and chopped nuts, drizzle a little honey. Freeze for two hours, then snap it into shards.

atoms.title: Date and cocoa truffles
atoms.body: Blitz soft dates with a handful of nuts and two spoons of cocoa until it clumps. Roll into balls, then roll them in more cocoa.

atoms.title: Baked pears with ginger and honey
atoms.body: Halve pears, scoop out the cores, add a little grated ginger and a drizzle of honey. Bake for 25 minutes. A spoon of yoghurt on top.

atoms.title: Little pavlovas with yoghurt and berries
atoms.body: Whisk egg whites stiff, add sugar a spoon at a time, pipe small nests and bake low and slow. Fill with thick yoghurt and berries just before serving.

atoms.title: A parfait in a glass
atoms.body: Yoghurt, then berries, then a spoon of granola, and repeat. Make it in a nice glass and it's a pudding.

atoms.title: One square of dark chocolate, slowly
atoms.body: Break off one square. Let it melt on your tongue instead of chewing. It lasts a surprisingly long time.

atoms.title: Proper hot cocoa
atoms.body: Whisk a spoon of cocoa and a little honey into warm milk, with a pinch of cinnamon. Warm, not boiling. Both hands round the mug.

atoms.title: Fruit crumble with an oat top
atoms.body: Chop whatever fruit is going soft into a dish. Rub oats, flour, butter and a few chopped nuts together for the top. Bake until it bubbles at the edges.

atoms.title: Why whole fruit is the gentlest sweet
atoms.body: Whole fruit brings its own fibre and water with its sugar, so it fills you up and goes in more slowly than the same sugar on its own. That's most of the magic in here.

atoms.title: Level up any sweet spell
atoms.body: A pinch of flaky salt on chocolate. Lemon zest on berries. Toasted nuts on yoghurt. Small things, big difference.
